relatedSnapshot.title: Acquisity Charge After Cancellation + Pending $1,200 AIA course Refund
relatedSnapshot.description:
#### User Email

<email>

#### Workspace Name

Company Two's Workspace

#### Request Type

Refund

#### Reason for request

Client is requesting refunds related to both his Acquisity membership and canceled AIA membership.

The client previously canceled his Acquisity subscription but reported a new charge of approximately $171.70 USD afterward. He provided a screenshot of the charge and confirmed that <email> is the only email address associated with his account.

Name 17 has double-checked both the client’s Whop and Acquisity accounts and confirmed that he cannot see any ongoing/active subscription on either platform. Name 17 had previously also confirmed that the Acquisity subscription should already be canceled. At this stage, the source of the recent ~$171.70 charge is unclear and needs further investigation.

Separately, the client is still awaiting a $1,200 USD refund for his canceled AIA course. Name 18 previously advised that the refund process had been completed and was awaiting payout, but the client has followed up multiple times and reports that he still has not received the funds.

Please investigate the source of the recent Acquisity charge and process the applicable refund, as well as confirm the current status of the outstanding $1,200 AIA membership refund.
